mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_message (user_id, order_id, type, title, content, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{orderId}, #{type}, IFNULL(#{title}, ''), IFNULL(#{content}, ''), 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_message WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE t_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
